_comment: Retail SKUs temporarily grandfathered below the gross-margin floor. Prefer fixing the price or the cost. Every entry MUST carry a reason -- an unexplained exemption is how a 44%-margin product quietly ships for a year. Remove an entry the moment it is resolved.
